questions.question: Which sentence uses the present perfect correctly to describe an action that happened at an unspecified time in the past?
options: I lost my keys yesterday.
I have lost my keys.
I had lost my keys.
I was losing my keys.

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative form to complete the sentence: "This movie is ______ than the one I saw last week."
options: more interesting
more interested
interestinger
most interesting

questions.question: Which option correctly uses the second conditional to talk about an imaginary situation?
options: If I have time, I will help you.
If I had time, I would help you.
If I have time, I would help you.
If I had time, I will help you.
questions.answer: If I had time, I would help you.

questions.question: Select the sentence that correctly uses a gerund after the preposition 'enjoy'.
options: I enjoy swimming in the lake.
I enjoy to swim in the lake.
I enjoy swimming at the lake.
I enjoy swim in the lake.
questions.answer: I enjoy swimming in the lake.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the modal verb 'should' to give advice?
options: You should go to bed earlier.
You should to go to bed earlier.
You should going to bed earlier.
You should go to bed earlierly.
questions.answer: You should go to bed earlier.

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the most appropriate linker: "______ it was raining heavily, we decided to go for a walk."
options: Because
Although
So
If

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the past continuous tense?
options: I was sleeping when the phone rang.
I sleep when the phone rang.
I slept when the phone rang.
I am sleeping when the phone rang.
questions.answer: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence to express a future plan using 'be going to'.
options: I am going to visit my grandmother tomorrow.
I will going to visit my grandmother tomorrow.
I go to visit my grandmother tomorrow.
I am going to visiting my grandmother tomorrow.
questions.answer: I am going to visit my grandmother tomorrow.

questions.question: Which word is the correct antonym for 'generous'?
options: kind
generous
stingy
generous

questions.question: Select the sentence that correctly uses the third conditional to describe a past hypothetical situation.
options: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
If I had known the answer, I would have told you.
If I knew the answer, I would have told you.
If I had known the answer, I will tell you.
questions.answer: If I had known the answer, I would have told you.
